entities.title: Usage log
entities.summary: One JSON line per internal tool call (made by daemon) and per hook decision that blocked or let a raw command through, correlated by the caller's stable session in usage.jsonl in the state directory.
entities.name: usage.jsonl
entities.meaning: What an agent asked, how the answer was produced and what it cost: the input csharp-indexer report summarises to decide what to build next.
dimensions: v: record version (2; older records use 1)
session: the daemon or MCP session shared by all calls in one agent conversation, or Claude Code's session_id for hook records
args: argument names with numbers and booleans as given and strings as 12-hex SHA-256 prefixes; in arrays the first element and flags are kept
path: how the answer was produced (index, run:git, view, hook; scan, fallback:<engine> and run:<program> in records from earlier versions)

reason: why, when not plainly from the index (git, gap_report, blocked:<program>, allowed_raw:<program>; earlier versions also wrote index_cold, regex_unsupported, passthrough and unchanged_since_last_read)
bytes_out and est_tokens (about 3.5 UTF-8 bytes per token) of the answer, plus a 12-hex SHA-256 response_hash
source_bytes, source_lines and source_est_tokens for a view's input before compaction
results, truncated, candidates, files: what the tool reported (candidates and files are -1 when the tool does not count them)
note: report_gap text (from zazzle_report_gap), cut to 500 characters
error: the tool's error code, or null
entities.access: The user who owns the state directory; nothing is sent anywhere.
entities.retention: When usage.jsonl passes 20 MiB it is renamed to usage.jsonl.1 (replacing the previous one) before the next write; nothing else is deleted.
excludes: Argument text, unless ZAZZLE_INDEXER_LOG_PLAIN=1 (the report_gap note is stored in the note field in plain text either way)
Answer text (only its size and hash are kept)
Hook calls that were simply allowed
entities.details: Write failures are ignored, and a state directory that cannot be created disables the hook's logging. `csharp-indexer report` combines this producer log with daemon's final-delivery log to show compaction and session-dedupe savings. A user-facing pointer to both logs stays in the README's Usage log section.

entities.title: Notes on standard error
entities.summary: serve says when it falls back to serving in process, and the index says when change tracking is unavailable for a root.
entities.meaning: "csharp-indexer: no daemon (<reason>); serving in-process" means the shared daemon could not be reached or used; "csharp-indexer: change tracking unavailable for <root> (<message>); relying on periodic reconcile" means the root is refreshed only every five minutes and by query barriers.
entities.access: Whoever reads the process's standard error: the MCP client for serve; for a spawned daemon it goes to /dev/null.
